summary:
This task adds OperationAddForm (a form component collecting Название/Надбавка %/Доп. минуты/Доп. материал/шт) and wires DeleteRowButton into the two existing per-mode Усложнения/Операции row lists — the same pattern already reviewed clean in Task 3 (Изделия), applied to the second of the three sibling blocks. `git show fe3355b --stat` confirms exactly one file changed (client/src/pages/Panel.jsx, +125/-2), zero server-side edits. XSS check: the new operation name is rendered exactly once per row site as plain `{name}` JSX text-child interpolation, inside `{name}` (Panel.jsx:1306 quick-mode 'Усложнения' row, Panel.jsx:1373 masterpiece-mode 'Операции' row) — both are pre-existing interpolation sites the diff wraps in a new `
` alongside the new `DeleteRowButton`, without altering how `name` itself is rendered. `OperationAddForm`'s own draft-name field is a controlled input (`value={draft.name}` at Panel.jsx, `updateField("name")` onChange`), setting the DOM `.value` property, not `innerHTML`. Grepped the whole file for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`/`innerHTML`/`eval`/`new Function`: zero matches, confirming Task 4 introduces no new raw-HTML sink. A name like `` typed into 'Название' would render as inert text in both mode branches and in the form's own text input — no stored/reflected/DOM XSS. Defense-in-depth check: `validateSettings` (server/internal/service/costing.go:634-644) is completely untouched by this diff (confirmed via `git show fe3355b --stat`, client-only commit) and still runs on every `POST /api/v1/users/settings`, independently re-checking `strings.TrimSpace(name) == ""` and `AdditionalMinutes >= 0`, `AdditionalMaterialPerUnit >= 0`, `QuickPercent >= 0` for every operation key server-side, regardless of what the client sent — the client-side `validateOperationFields`/`isDuplicateName` checks invoked by `OperationAddForm.handleAdd` mirror these bounds exactly (both use `>= 0`, matching Task 4's stated deviation from Task 3's garment `> 0` bounds) but remain a UX convenience layer, not the sole gate; a request forged directly against the API still gets the same backend rejection. deepseek.go check: server/internal/service/deepseek.go is untouched by this diff (same client-only commit) and still builds its market-feedback prompt via unescaped operation names (via `formatOperationCountsForPrompt(input.OperationCounts)`, deepseek.go ~400) exactly as before Task 4. This task adds no new server-reachable path to deepseek.go, no change to accepted characters or name length (client validation touches only the three numeric fields, never the name string's content beyond blank/duplicate checks). This is the same pre-existing, tech-spec-documented, user-approved risk (Risks table: 'Garment/operation names typed via the new add-forms flow unescaped into an AI market-feedback prompt') already reviewed and accepted at Task 3 — Task 4's OperationAddForm is that same documented reachability extended to the second data type, not a new or worsened risk. No findings requiring action; one informational note below for the record, consistent with Task 3's report.

findings.description: Verified the specific scenario requested: an operation name typed into the new `OperationAddForm` (e.g. `` or ``) flows through `handleAddOperation` into `settings.operations[name]`, and back out through plain `{name}` JSX text-child interpolation at both existing row-render sites this task added a `DeleteRowButton` next to. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, or manual HTML-string construction exists anywhere in Panel.jsx (whole-file grep, not diff-scoped). The controlled `` in the add-form is likewise safe.
